messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a fractional ramp for `v2-routing` tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Plan is 1% -> 5% -> 25% with 30m windows. Who's owning deploy + smoke?
linus: I can own the deploy + ramps. Confirmation: cohorts = geo slices + new-sessions-only?
maya: Yes — target cohorts: EU-west and NA-east. Cohort rule: new sessions only (session_create_time > deploy_ts). Exclude internal/test accounts.
alex: +1 for new sessions-only. Fallback plan: keep previous model pinned for instant rollback, right?
sophie: Correct. Fallback is previous model pinned and immediate failover. Smoke SLO: 95th latency < 250ms and error rate < 0.5% per slice.
maya: Smoke commands to run after canary spin:
```
./scripts/smoke/run_smoke.sh --model v2-routing --cohort eu-west
cat ./smoke/reports/latest.json
```
linus: I'll trigger the canary at 03:00 and run smoke at ~03:05. @sre-oncall can you monitor traces and set a temporary dashboard for the windows?
sre-oncall: I'm on it. Will watch traces + set ephemeral dashboard. Ping when we hit 5% and I'll intensify monitoring.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued by linus at 2001234567. Canary replicas: 4. Auto-scaling disabled during ramp.
alex: One more: we should warm caches before traffic ramps. Suggest running `scripts/prime/prime.sh --endpoint /v1/route --parallel 200` for ~5m.
maya: Good call. Linus, include cache-warm in pre-ramp steps.
linus: Added. Full pre-ramp checklist in order:
- 02:55: run cache warm (prime.sh)
- 03:00: start canary at 1%
- 03:05: run smoke suite + validate reports
- 03:10: ramp to 5%
- 03:20: ramp to 25%
- 03:40: evaluate and proceed to broader rollout if all green
maya: Rollback triggers (immediate rollback + page): any slice error rate > 1% OR 95th latency increase > 150ms vs baseline. Also if model output regressions detected by evaluation hooks.
sre-oncall: I'll set alerts: error_rate_threshold=1% and latency_delta_threshold=150ms for the windows. I'll also post links to traces in thread when ready.
sophie: We'll snapshot token-cost and qps before start and after each ramp step to track unit economics.
billing-bot: Notified of upcoming ramp window and snapshot request.
maya: Thanks everyone. If no blockers I'll start the deploy at 03:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
linus: Ready. I'll post short updates here at each step.
sre-oncall: Acknowledged — I'll watch and ping in-thread on any anomalies.
_meta: generated for dataset realism: fractional ramp, geo cohorts, smoke checklist, rollback rules
